articles.summary: Altria Group, Inc. (“Altria”) notes the recent press speculation regarding a possible offer for Imperial Brands plc (“Imperial Brands”) and confirms that we are considering a possible offer for Imperial Brands. Any offer, if made, is likely to be solely in cash. We also confirm that we are in discussions with a third party regarding its possible acquisition of part of the business of Imperial Brands, however no agreement has yet been reached. There can be no certainty that an offer will ultimately be made nor as to the terms on which any offer may be made. This announcement is made in accordance with Rule 2.4 of the UK City Code on Takeovers and Mergers (the "Code") and does not constitute a firm intention to make an offer under Rule 2.7 of the Code. Rule 2.6(a) of the Code requires that Altria, by no later than 5:00 p.m. (London time) on December 24, 2026, being the 28th day following the date of this announcement, either announces a firm intention to make an offer for Imperial
articles.title: Altria Response to Media Speculation on Possible Offer for Imperial Brands plc
